title: Handbook of the Linked Knuckle Strikes
summary: A handbook that chains jab and cross into qi-backed runs of blows with a brass knuckle-duster.

title: Treatise on the Brass Combination
summary: A treatise on four-blow combinations that guard first and strike second for students holding a basic fist manual.

title: Manual of the Weighted Fist Rhythm
summary: A manual that teaches an even beat of heavy brass-fisted blows and how to break an opponent's beat.

title: Canon of the Close-Range Pressure Fist
summary: A canon of crowding blows and pins used at arm's reach to press a stronger opponent off balance.

title: Course in Breaking the Guard with Brass
summary: A course for forcing a way through a raised guard with wedge pokes and qi-backed knocks of the brass.

title: Drill-Book of the Counter Knuckle
summary: A drill-book of late counters, bait taps and reversal blows for the student who prefers to answer and not lead.

title: Treatise on the Qi-Set Boss Point
summary: A treatise on setting qi into the raised boss of the duster so a single point bores through armor or cloth.

title: Handbook of the Rolling Ring Combination
summary: A handbook of wheeling combinations that roll under and past an opponent's guard while the rings keep striking.
